help_desc: Shows the proxy-detection status: provider, action mode, blocked types, cache and query count.
msg_denied: You are not allowed to use this command.
msg_fail_alert: [ PROXYDETECT ]--> provider '%s' lookups failing: %d errors in %ds, so detection is degraded (fail-%s).
msg_key_missing: etc_proxydetect.lua: provider '%s' needs an API key (etc_proxydetect_api_key or LUADCH_ETC_PROXYDETECT_API_KEY), so the plugin is inert.
msg_provider_bad: etc_proxydetect.lua: unknown provider '%s'. The plugin is inert. Set etc_proxydetect_provider to one of: %s.
msg_quota: etc_proxydetect.lua: daily query cap (%d) reached. Skipping lookups (fail-open) until the window resets.
msg_report: [ PROXYDETECT ]--> The user %s with IP %s is a %s (%s). Action: %s.
msg_tos_note: etc_proxydetect.lua: provider '%s'. Review its free-tier terms (see docs/BLOCKLIST.md): %s.
